description:
Universal Media Server is a DLNA-compliant UPnP Media Server. It is capable of sharing video, audio and images between most modern devices.


Here's a bugfix release for v15 while we continue to work on v16.
It fixes slow browsing since 15.8.0 (sorry!), DVD ISO support, and broken browsing of parent directories when children are added.
Thanks for reporting bugs to us so we can squash them!
Full changelog
General
- Fixed slow browsing since 15.8.0
- Fixed DVD ISO browsing
- Fixed broken browsing of parent when new folder is added
Translation updates via Crowdin
- Russian (100%) (thanks, vanapro1!)
